description:
Overview 
 At Credence, we support our clients’ mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We provide cutting-edge solutions, including AI/ML, enterprise modernization, and advanced intelligence capabilities, to the largest defense and health federal organizations. Through partnership and trust, we increase mission success for war-fighters and secure our nation for a better future. 
 We are privately held, are repeatedly recognized as a top place to work, and have been on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies list for the last 12 years. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success. 
 Credence has an immediate need for a Software Engineer at journeyman level to support our Distributed Common Ground System (DCGS) program at Robins AFB, GA. The Air Force Distributed Common Ground System (AF DCGS) is an intelligence enterprise system, comprised of 27 active duty, Air National Guard (ANG), and mission partner sites, interconnected by a robust communications infrastructure spanning the globe.
 The Software Engineer will perform work that applies a broad theoretical and practical knowledge of SW engineering to include but not be limited to reviewing, preparing, and analyzing all types of documentation: Planning, requirements, design, V&V, support and test. Also, include source code, configuration files and engineering resolution support.
 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below: 
 Determining operational feasibility by evaluating data, analyses, technical reports, requirements, and proposed solutions of assigned systems or programs
 Documenting and demonstrating solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
 Improving operations by conducting systems analysis; recommending changes in policies and procedures
 Obtaining and licensing SW by obtaining required information from vendors; recommending purchases; testing and approving products
 Providing information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing development and service issues
 Accomplish engineering and organization mission by completing related items, as needed
 Performing SW Quality Assurance to ensure that developed SW meets and complies with defined or standardized quality specifications.
 Working as a member of an agile SW development team. Performing some mix of the below tasks as directed by the Government team leader or engineering lead
 Elaborate high level feature/function descriptions into detailed technical designs and tasks, in collaboration with users (from Lead Command or operating units) and Government lead engineers
 Perform coding tasks for features/functions
 Perform coding tasks for functional and performance tests for features/functions
 Perform peer design and code reviews with other team members
 Perform coding/scripting tasks for SW build, packaging, and deployment
 Perform other SW engineering and documentation tasks as assigned
 Requirements 
 A minimum of a Top-Secret security clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) eligibility is required
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or computer science from an ABET- accredited university and three (3) years of experience in the respective technical / professional discipline being performed, three (3) years of which must be in DoD acquisition.
 OR, seven (7) years of directly related experience with proper certification as described in the PWS labor category performance requirements, five of which must be in the DoD.
 Required Experience and Skills: 
 Relevant experience includes duties related to AF LCM of weapon systems or weapon system products, identifying technical requirements and deliverables for weapon systems, and validating and verifying product deliveries to ensure adherence of the product to identified requirements. 
 Familiarity with AF LCM processes is required. 
 Knowledge of regulations, policies, and operating instructions as they pertain to the preparation of technical documents, technical data, and systems engineering execution is required.
 Experience with the programming language specific to the weapon system or program for which the position will support is required; programming languages are non-proprietary and common to other industries (C++, Common Business Oriented Language, Java, Hypertext Markup Language, or C#, etc.) 
 Required Professional Qualifications :
 Cybersecurity Qualification is required for Work Role ID 441, Network Operations Specialist. Candidate meets the requirements of Department of Defense Manual (DoDM) 8140.03 Cyberspace Workforce Qualification and Management Program for the Work Role identified in the job description 
 Cyber Work Roles are defined here: https://public.cyber.mil/wid/dcwf/ 
 Cyber Work Role qualifications are defined in the DoD 8140 Foundational Qualification Options matrix here: https://public.cyber.mil/wid/cwmp/documents-library/    
 Acquisition Qualification: 
 Defense Acquisition University (DAU) credential program, CACQ 010 Foundational Acquisition Intelligence Credential
 Or Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Acquisition Professional Development Program (APDP), any level
 Or a degree or certificate in LCM, Product LCM, or related field from any University or learning institute accredited by a U.S. Department of Education approved accrediting organization  
 Systems Engineering Qualification: 
 Systems Engineering Certificate or Degree from an Accreditation Board of Engineering and Technology (ABET) accredited school
 Or DAWIA APDP Certification in the Engineering & Technical Management functional area, Level II, 
 Or International Council on Systems Engineering certification: Associate Systems Engineering Professional, or Certified Systems Engineering Professional, or Expert Systems Engineering Professional certification.
 Benefits 
 Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
 Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
 Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
 Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
 Short Term & Long Term Disability
 Training & Development
